title: Mandarin character-usage lesson (v2 compatibility + v3.0.0)
description: v3 adds course-neutral classification, learning objectives and type; previous character schemas remain supported for migration. Optional global subtopics are validated against the shared taxonomy.

catalog_character_id.description: The exact ID of headword.hanzi from catalog_ids.json, or null if unavailable. Never synthesize or translate an ID.

pinyin.description: Tone-marked Hanyu Pinyin for the headword. Pinyin words may contain multiple syllables without spaces; character-to-syllable alignment must account for that orthography.

lesson.description: Learner-facing title and discovery metadata; stable lesson_id and headword remain at root.

title.description: Short, communicative learning goal; never merely a Hanzi gloss.

subtitle.description: Optional concise explanation, suitable for a card.

description.description: A complete, searchable summary covering the main domains actually taught.

label.description: Human readable category label, shared across related lessons.

slug.description: URL-friendly lesson slug; not the permanent unique lesson_id.

catalog_character_refs.description: Lookup table for every catalog-resolvable Chinese character appearing in the learner-visible lesson. Keys are individual written characters (not words); values are exact catalog_ids.json IDs. Missing catalog entries are omitted, not guessed. Neither pinyin nor lexical word IDs are derived from this table.

primary_topic_id.description: Global topic key or null only when no global category reasonably applies.

course_topic_refs.description: Optional cross-references to course-private topics; not curriculum membership.

primary_subtopic_id.description: Optional primary global subtopic; must belong to an assigned topic parent.

subtopic_ids.description: Optional stable global subtopic IDs from the topic registry.

icon_glyph.description: Optional one-character card glyph. Else frontend maps primary_topic_id to its themed default. No color value is stored.

estimated_minutes.description: Optional editorial duration estimate for display only. Never use to calculate progress.

pinyin.description: Tone-marked Hanyu Pinyin; standard word segmentation and apostrophes when needed for syllable boundaries.
Tone-marked Hanyu Pinyin with standard word spacing and apostrophes at ambiguous syllable boundaries.

pattern_hanzi.description: Hanzi grammar pattern; use identical structural symbols and placeholders in pattern_pinyin (e.g. X, Y, +, commas, ellipses).

pattern_pinyin.description: Pinyin equivalent of pattern_hanzi; copy placeholders and structural punctuation exactly; romanize Chinese words.

pattern_pseudo_translation.description: Optional plain-text third line. Use <English placeholder> for replaceable parts, and keep fixed Mandarin and structural punctuation. This line is display-only.

pinyin.description: Full sentence in standard tone-marked Hanyu Pinyin, corresponding to the Chinese reading; preserve word spacing and needed apostrophes. Character/syllable alignment is a separate linguistic check, not guaranteed by JSON Schema alone.

english.description: Natural, complete English sentence with final punctuation matching its discourse function.

correct_choice_ids.description: Authoritative answer key. Each ID must exist in choices, with unique choice IDs. In single selection exactly one key, multiple selection two or more; no answer string duplicates for choice questions. Cross-field validation is performed by the generator.

progress.description: Canonical authored checklist layout, NOT learner state. Completion is count of nonoptional checkpoints, independent of elapsed time. Client stores completed checkpoint IDs separately.

section_key.description: Semantic section identifier for UI grouping; do not infer it from nested JSON indexes.

id.description: Permanent learner-progress key; retain across content changes/reordering.

optional.description: Optional checkpoints never block core completion.

target_id.description: Exact ID of the corresponding source item when there is one. For section acknowledgements omit target_id.
